description: This file contains functions and types for normalizing and processing cron job configurations, including schedule, payload, delivery, and session target normalization, with support for defaults and context-based resolution.

methods.name: hasTrimmedStringValue
methods.description: Checks if a value has a non-empty trimmed string using parseOptionalField.

methods.name: hasAgentTurnPayloadHint
methods.description: Determines if a payload has fields indicating an agent turn payload.

methods.name: normalizeTrimmedStringArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings by trimming and filtering out empty strings; supports null allowance.

methods.name: coerceSchedule
methods.description: Converts a schedule object into a normalized form with explicit kind and at fields.

methods.name: coercePayload
methods.description: Normalizes payload object fields, including kind, message, text, model, and others.

methods.name: coerceDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes delivery object fields such as mode, channel, to, threadId, accountId.

methods.name: inferTopLevelPayload
methods.description: Infers top-level payload type based on message, text, or payload hints.

methods.name: unwrapJob
methods.description: Extracts job data from raw object, checking data and job properties.

methods.name: normalizeSessionTarget
methods.description: Normalizes session target strings, supporting 'main', 'isolated', 'current', and 'session:' prefix.

methods.name: normalizeWakeMode
methods.description: Normalizes wake mode strings, supporting 'now' and 'next-heartbeat'.

methods.name: copyTopLevelAgentTurnFields
methods.description: Copies model and thinking fields from next to payload if missing or empty.

methods.name: stripLegacyTopLevelFields
methods.description: Removes legacy top-level fields from the object.

methods.name: normalizeCronJobInput
methods.description: Main function to normalize a raw cron job input object, applying defaults and context resolution.

methods.name: normalizeCronJobCreate
methods.description: Normalizes input for creating a cron job, with defaults applied.

methods.name: normalizeCronJobPatch
methods.description: Normalizes input for patching a cron job, without applying defaults.
